pr_body:
# Objective

Our [`TextSpan`](https://docs.rs/bevy/latest/bevy/prelude/struct.TextSpan.html) docs include a code example that does not actually "work." The code silently does not render anything, and the `Text*Writer` helpers fail.

This seems to be by design, because we can't use `Text` or `Text2d` from `bevy_ui` or `bevy_sprite` within docs in `bevy_text`. (Correct me if I am wrong)

I have seen multiple users confused by these docs.

Also fixes #16794

## Solution

Remove the code example from `TextSpan`, and instead encourage users to seek docs on `Text` or `Text2d`.

Add examples with nested `TextSpan`s in those areas.

issue_context.title: TextUiReader requires a parent Text to function, despite TextSpan docs
issue_context.body:
## Bevy version

Bevy 0.15.0

## What you did

I constructed a root `TextLayout` with child `TextSpans`, as per the [`TextSpan` documentation](https://docs.rs/bevy/latest/bevy/prelude/struct.TextSpan.html).

## What went wrong

`TextUiReader` should allow me to properly iterate over the child `TextSpan`s of the entity with `TextLayout`, but it will return an empty iterator if there is no root parent `Text` component.

I'm not sure what the expected behavior is here; if I don't want to use a root `Text` component, should `TextUiReader` still work? Or is the example for `TextSpan` incorrect?
comments: When the expected behavior is made clear, I'll update the status again.

review_comments: Shouldn't this have a `Text` or `Text2d` component here as part of the example?

Oh I see we can't use them in doc examples?

I think it would be better to just remove it completely, even with the extra comment it's still no good if it doesn't work.

Yep, but this is in `bevy_text`, which doesn't have `bevy_ui` and/or `bevy_sprite` as a dependency, so I don't think we can do that? 

That is what I am trying to convey in the PR description.
What about removing this `TextSpan` example as it's not helpful and adding a `// With TextSpans` section to the `Text` and `Text2d` doc examples?
Totally fine with removing it, especially if we add some explicit language guiding users over to `Text` and `Text2d`.
Yeah I think that would be best.
